status: EMPTY: no operator has been measured. Every op's kernel time is the analytical model (costSource analytical, evidence MODEL).

schema.id: unique string, cited by the ops that use it
schema.op: mappedPlan op name, exactly as in plan.ops (e.g. 'QK (absorbed MLA)')
schema.shape: {flops, readBytes, writeBytes}: the op's card-level flops and bytes as mappedPlan sees them before mapping (out/detailed/cost_coverage.json lists the shapes the published point needs)
schema.hardware: values of every key in cost_provider.js HW_KEYS for the design point measured
schema.kernelUs: kernel body time on the card in microseconds: matrix/vector/unpack body only, without shared->local staging, flush, reduce, die link or launch, and before fused online-softmax hiding
schema.evidence: SILICON_OBSERVED (silicon, prototype or FPGA; docs/architecture/14_TPS_OBSERVATION_METRICS.md section 3) or EMULATION_OBSERVED (RTL simulation or Palladium emulation)
schema.source: where the number comes from: run log, report or artifact path
schema.environment: toolchain, RTL/netlist version, clock, firmware and settings of the run

rules: An exact match on op, shape and hardware replaces the analytical kernel (costSource measured).

Two observations of the same op and hardware whose shapes bracket the query on a line give a linear interpolation (costSource fitted, the weaker evidence of the two). There is no extrapolation: outside the sampled segment the op falls back to the analytical value.
Numbers from references/ or other external papers are not observations of this hardware and may not be entered here.
